'''Skara Nal''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Kaldar Trinary system]] in [[the galaxy]]. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]], [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]], [[MEL]]-221, and members of [[Clone Force 99|the Bad Batch]] went to the [[planet]] in [[Discovery on Skara Nal|search]] of treasure. They instead found an ancient [[Skara Nal Mech|walker]] [[superweapon]]. Genoa activated the walker and revealed its true nature when she removed the [[Heart of the Mountain]] [[crystal]] keeping it deactivated. The walker went on a brief rampage before Genoa was persuaded to return the crystal to its original position so the weapon could not destroy the Bad Batch's [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|starship]] and leave them all stranded. Replacing the crystal halted the walker, but also destroyed it and the crystal.

==Description==
Skara Nal was a [[planet]] situated in the [[Kaldar Trinary system]]. Terrestrial with an [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s, it was [[orbit]]ed by at least one [[moon]] and itself revolved around a [[trinary star]]. Much of the planet's surface was razed and uninhabitable, with [[Death|dead]] [[forest]]s, [[mountain]]s, and valleys.<ref name="Entombed" /> The surface also consisted of fossilized rock and dull stone outcroppings. There were no cities or any sign of civilization anywhere on the planet.<ref name="Skara Nal">{{Databank|skara-nal|Skara Nal}}</ref> [[Chell (creature)|Chell]] lived on the planet.<ref name="Entombed" />

==History==
===A pirate folk tale===
The [[Ancients (Skara Nal)|Ancients]], a group predating the [[Jedi Order]], built an ancient [[Skara Nal Mech|walker]] prior to the formation of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Entombed" /> in approximately [[25,000 BBY]].<ref name="Republic">''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' dates the formation of the [[Galactic Republic]] to around 25,000 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to approximately [[25,000 BBY]] in the [['ABY-BBY' dating system|dating system]] used by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> The walker was set loose on the planet at one point, with its primary weapon carving deep gouges into the planet and rendering much of the area inhospitable to life. The walker was eventually stopped and buried inside a mountain. A [[crystal]] known as the [[Heart of the Mountain]] plugged into a socket in the walker's control room kept it inert, while a series of booby traps protected the chamber. Over the [[Millennium|millennia]], the walker became a [[pirate]] legend, mythologized as a [[city]] containing a crystal of immense power that held enormous value.<ref name="Entombed" />

===Imperial Era===
Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|205}}</ref> during the early [[Imperial Era]], a [[Omega's Compass|compass]] designed to lead the way and allow entrance to the walker was discovered in a [[Unidentified junkyard|junkyard]]<ref name="Entombed" /> on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> planet [[Ord Mantell]] by [[Omega]], a member of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]], a group of rogue [[Cloning|clone]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]<ref name="Entombed" /> in hiding from the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Spoils of War">{{TBB|Spoils of War}}</ref> Omega had taken to collecting pieces of potentially-valuable junk to show to [[Phee Genoa]], a [[pirate]] and treasure hunter with which the team had recently become acquainted.<ref name="Entombed" />

On her return with [[Wrecker]] to [[Cid's Parlor]], the [[cantina]] they were based out of, Omega showed her findings to Genoa. The pirate noticed the [[compass]] had coordinate markings and had her [[droid]] [[MEL]]-221 scan it, placing the coordinates in the Kaldar Trinary [[Star system|system]]. Intrigued, Genoa persuaded the rest of the team to accompany her on a treasure hunt there. The group ventured to the planet in the Bad Batch's [[starship]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']].<ref name="Entombed" />

Afterwards, the group landed on the planet and saw the desolate landscape of the planet. While the group were discussing the planets landscape, Echo realized that the compass activated and was pointing south from their position. Excited, Omega snatched the compass from [[Echo]] and headed to where the compass was pointing at. After reaching the location that the compass was pointing at, the group found themselves at a dead end. Assuming that there was a secret entrance, Phee asked Wrecker to move some rocks. After moving some rocks, a secret entrance to the walker was revealed and the Bad Batch entered it.<ref name="Entombed" />

While exploring the walker, the group solved many puzzles and challenges that were presented to them. Eventually, the group reached a chamber that housed the Heart of the Mountain. Phee immediately took the Heart of the Mountain which consequently activated the walker. The ancient droid walker then proceeded to annihilate everything on the planet. To stop the droid walker from destroying their ship, the group managed to place the Heart of the Mountain back to where it was previously thereby deactivating and later destroying the droid walker. The ''Marauder'' then left the planet.<ref name="Entombed" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skara Nal appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] episode "[[Entombed]],"<ref name="Entombed" /> released on [[January 25]], [[2023]].<ref name="Airdate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref>
